metadata.description: Plugin marketplace for the Issuegraph toolchain.

plugins.name: issuegraph-skills
plugins.description: Read and write the Issuegraph block in GitHub issue bodies through the `issuegraph` CLI — dependency edges, priority, evidence, and derived selection order. Covers the parse/validate/order/ready/set/splice/backfill verbs, and leads with the trap that `parse` exits 0 even when the block was unreadable, so the `state` field in stdout is the condition to read, not the exit code.
